pr_title: Add chat display during multiplayer gameplay
pr_body:
For now, this toggles along with the other elements (based on HUD visibility). Seems to work okay for now.

Chat can also be focused via the `Tab` key.

- [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/14358.
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/12402

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/129681351-fd39af4e-2c15-4c4d-806b-f33d88520ba0.mp4
pr_comments:
Two things:
1. I don't think the textbox should ever focus during gameplay.
2. There's no way to select the textbox when you have overlay visibility mode set to "never". I'd expect pressing tab to show the overlay for the entire duration that the textbox is focused.
Hmm, so you want it to be non-interactive during gameplay? Maybe with the exception of the key being pressed?
Yeah I can agree with non interactive unless keybind is pressed.
Sounds fine, will also update the naming of the binding.

issue_context.title: Make multiplayer chat visible during gameplay / results
issue_context.body:
**Describe the new feature:** 

In osu!stable, when you are in a multiplayer room, the chat overlay is always opened and the multiplayer chat tab is fixed at the beggining of all the tabs.
In osu!lazer, the multiplayer chat is separate from the overlay which contain all the chat tabs, so it looks like there is no need to make the room's chat tab be fixed in the chat overlay, but when the game starts, it's common for players to use the room's tab in the chat overlay to communicate something to the players while you are in a rest section of the map or when the gameplay is loading at the beggining.
Currently, it's hard to find the current room's tab in osu!lazer because it is always at the end and can be confusing because the name is always "lazermp_" along with some numbers, the idea is to make the current room chat tab be fixed at the beggining of the tab list in the chat overlay and maybe rename it to "multiplayer" as stable does.
comments: we'll probably show a separate control for multiplayer chat, rather than use the global one.

review_comments: Judging from the code, this needs a `setLocalUserPlaying(true)` at the start to pass.
Weird, I guess I was always getting this from a previous step when testing.
